sources.title: Associates Program Policies (Commission Income Statement; Participation Requirements; Products Statement)
sources.method: fetch, chunks 0–10 of 11 (all read; chunks 0–8 re-read on 2026-11-20 to settle section numbers)
verified_statements: Commission Income Statement §1(b): a session runs for 24 hours from the click; orders placed within 89 days of the click count, subject to the 180-day shipment rule.
Commission Income Statement §2(d)–(e): purchases referred by a link shown on a search engine, or by a redirecting link, are disqualified.
Participation Requirements §1: 'Your Site(s) must contain original content and be publicly available via the website address provided in the application.'

Participation Requirements §2(a)–(b): 'Special Links must use the Associates ID we have assigned to you.' and 'you must include your Associates ID or "tag" ... as a parameter in the URL of each link you place on your Site to an Amazon Site.'
Participation Requirements §2(b): prices and availability may be shown only where Amazon serves the link, or through the Creators API or PA API under the License.
Participation Requirements §3(e): the site must disclose accurately the use of cookies, pixels, and other technologies, and the visitor's opt-out choices where required.
Participation Requirements §6(b): no links formatted with your Associates tag on a site that is not your Site.
Participation Requirements §6(t): customer reviews or star ratings may not be displayed unless obtained through the Creators API or PA API.
Participation Requirements §6(u): no purchases through your own Special Links.
Participation Requirements §6(w): no link-shortening service or other device that makes it unclear that the link goes to an Amazon Site.
Commission Income Statement §1(b): session ends 24 hours after the click; an order counts if placed within 89 days of the click (§1(b)(i)); shipment must occur within 180 days (§1(b)(iii)).

Commission Income Statement §2(b): orders with a cancellation, return, or refund initiated are disqualified. §2(g): purchases not correctly tracked because links are not properly formatted are disqualified.
Commission Income Statement §3: standard commission is a percentage of Qualifying Revenue (§1: excludes shipping, gift wrap, handling, taxes, service charges, credits, rebates, card fees, bad debt).
Participation Requirements §5: no Special Links in client-side software, with an exception for Approved Mobile Applications.
Participation Requirements §6(v): no cloaking of the site URL. §6(z): no Program Content used to promote products sold on non-Amazon sites.
Products Statement §3(a): excluded products include items sold on a site linked from an Amazon Site.
Trademark Guidelines §8: no trademark, domain, subdomain, or username confusingly similar to an Amazon mark.

IP License §1: link each use of Program Content solely to the related Product detail page. §2(h): images may not be stored or cached; links to images may be stored up to 24 hours. §2(i): a date/time stamp and disclaimer are required next to any displayed price or availability obtained from data feeds or the API.

sources.title: Safe Minimum Internal Temperature Chart
sources.page_updated: Last Updated: Apr 14, 2025 (as shown on page)
verified_statements: Beef, pork, veal and lamb steaks, chops and roasts: 145°F, rest at least 3 minutes.
Ground meats: 160°F. Ground poultry and all poultry: 165°F. Fish & shellfish: 145°F. Leftovers: 165°F.
'Cook all food to these minimum internal temperatures, as measured with a food thermometer, before removing food from the heat source.'
